sentences.text_target: It was a quiet Tuesday evening in the residential neighborhood.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ə ˈkwaɪət ˈtjuːzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ ɪn ðə ˌrɛzɪˈdɛnʃəl ˈneɪbəhʊd/
sentences.text_native: C'était un mardi soir calme dans le quartier résidentiel.

sentences.text_target: Sarah was returning home from the local grocery store.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə wɒz rɪˈtɜːnɪŋ həʊm frɒm ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈɡrəʊsəri stɔː/
sentences.text_native: Sarah rentrait chez elle de l'épicerie du coin.

sentences.text_target: She carried two heavy shopping bags in her hands.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈkærid tuː ˈhɛvi ˈʃɒpɪŋ bæɡz ɪn hɜː hændz/
sentences.text_native: Elle portait deux lourds sacs de courses dans les mains.

sentences.text_target: As she turned the corner, she noticed a shadow moving behind her.
sentences.phonetic: /æz ʃiː tɜːnd ðə ˈkɔːnə, ʃiː ˈnəʊtɪst ə ˈʃædəʊ ˈmuːvɪŋ bɪˈhaɪnd hɜː/
sentences.text_native: En tournant l'angle de la rue, elle remarqua une ombre qui bougeait derrière elle.

sentences.text_target: A suspicious individual seemed to follow her every step.
sentences.phonetic: /ə səˈspɪʃəs ˌɪndɪˈvɪdjʊəl siːmd tuː ˈfɒləʊ hɜː ˈɛvri stɛp/
sentences.text_native: Un individu suspect semblait suivre le moindre de ses pas.

sentences.text_target: She started to walk much faster along the dark street.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈstɑːtɪd tuː wɔːk mʌtʃ ˈfɑːstə əˈlɒŋ ðə dɑːk striːt/
sentences.text_native: Elle se mit à marcher beaucoup plus vite le long de la rue sombre.

sentences.text_target: Her heart began to beat very fast inside her chest.
sentences.phonetic: /hɜː hɑːt bɪˈɡæn tuː biːt ˈvɛri fɑːst ɪnˈsaɪd hɜː tʃɛst/
sentences.text_native: Son cœur se mit à battre très vite dans sa poitrine.

sentences.text_target: Panic and fear increased with every second that passed.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈpænɪk ænd fɪər ɪnˈkriːst wɪð ˈɛvri ˈsɛkənd ðæt pɑːst/
sentences.text_native: La panique et la peur grandissaient à chaque seconde qui s'écoulait.

sentences.text_target: She decided to enter a bright convenience store nearby.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈɛntə ə braɪt kənˈviːniəns stɔː ˈnɪəbaɪ/
sentences.text_native: Elle décida d'entrer dans une supérette bien éclairée à proximité.

sentences.text_target: The shop clerk looked at her pale face with concern.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ʃɒp klɑːk lʊkt æt hɜː peɪl feɪs wɪð kənˈsɜːn/
sentences.text_native: L'employé de la boutique observa son visage pâle avec inquiétude.

sentences.text_target: He understood immediately that she was in a dangerous situation.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˌʌndəˈstʊd ɪˈmiːdiətli ðæt ʃiː wɒz ɪn ə ˈdeɪndʒərəs ˌsɪtjʊˈeɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Il comprit immédiatement qu'elle se trouvait dans une situation dangereuse.

sentences.text_target: Without waiting, he locked the front glass door securely.
sentences.phonetic: /wɪðˈaʊt ˈweɪtɪŋ, hiː lɒkt ðə frʌnt ɡlɑːs dɔː sɪˈkjʊəli/
sentences.text_native: Sans attendre, il verrouilla solidement la porte vitrée de l'entrée.

sentences.text_target: He gave her clear instructions to stay away from the windows.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ɡeɪv hɜː klɪə ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz tuː steɪ əˈweɪ frɒm ðə ˈwɪndəʊz/
sentences.text_native: Il lui donna des instructions claires pour s'éloigner des fenêtres.

sentences.text_target: Sarah reached into her pocket and retrieved her mobile phone.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə riːtʃt ˈɪntuː hɜː ˈpɒkɪt ænd rɪˈtriːvd hɜː ˈməʊbaɪl fəʊn/
sentences.text_native: Sarah fouilla dans sa poche et sortit son téléphone portable.

sentences.text_target: She dialed the emergency number with trembling fingers.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈdaɪəld ði ɪˈmɜːdʒənsi ˈnʌmbə wɪð ˈtrɛmbəlɪŋ ˈfɪŋɡəz/
sentences.text_native: Elle composa le numéro d'urgence d'une main tremblante.

sentences.text_target: The phone connected quickly to the local police dispatch.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə fəʊn kəˈnɛktɪd ˈkwɪkli tuː ðə ˈləʊkəl pəˈliːs dɪˈspætʃ/
sentences.text_native: L'appel fut rapidement mis en relation avec le centre de répartition de la police locale.

sentences.text_target: A calm operator answered and asked her what was wrong.
sentences.phonetic: /ə kɑːm ˈɒpəreɪtə ˈɑːnsəd ænd ɑːskt hɜː wɒt wɒz rɒŋ/
sentences.text_native: Un opérateur au ton calme décrocha et lui demanda ce qui n'allait pas.

sentences.text_target: She tried to speak clearly and explained the incident.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː traɪd tuː spiːk ˈklɪəli ænd ɪksˈpleɪnd ði ˈɪnsɪdənt/
sentences.text_native: Elle s'efforça de parler clairement et expliqua l'incident.

sentences.text_target: The professional operator listened carefully and asked for her location.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə prəˈfɛʃənl ˈɒpəreɪtə ˈlɪsnɪd ˈkeəfʊli ænd ɑːskt fɔː hɜː ləʊˈkeɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: L'opérateur professionnel écouta attentivement et lui demanda sa position.

sentences.text_target: She gave the exact address of the small shop.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ɡeɪv ði ɪɡˈzækt əˈdrɛs ɒv ðə smɔːl ʃɒp/
sentences.text_native: Elle lui indiqua l'adresse exacte de la petite boutique.

sentences.text_target: The operator reassured her that help was already on the way.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈɒpəreɪtə ˌriːəˈʃʊəd hɜː ðæt hɛlp wɒz ɔːˈrɛdi ɒn ðə weɪ/
sentences.text_native: L'opérateur la rassura en lui affirmant que des secours étaient déjà en route.

sentences.text_target: Police units were immediately sent to investigate the area.
sentences.phonetic: /pəˈliːs ˈjuːnɪts wɜːr ɪˈmiːdiətli sɛnt tuː ɪnˈvɛstɪɡeɪt ði ˈeəriə/
sentences.text_native: Des patrouilles de police furent immédiatement envoyées pour inspecter les environs.

sentences.text_target: A few minutes later, the loud noise of sirens was heard.
sentences.phonetic: /ə fjuː ˈmɪnɪts ˈleɪtə, ðə laʊd nɔɪz ɒv ˈsaɪrənz wɒz hɜːd/
sentences.text_native: Quelques minutes plus tard, le hurlement de sirènes se fit entendre.

sentences.text_target: A police car arrived quickly with flashing blue and red lights.
sentences.phonetic: /ə pəˈliːs kɑːr əˈraɪvd ˈkwɪkli wɪð ˈflæʃɪŋ bluː ænd rɛd laɪts/
sentences.text_native: Une voiture de police arriva en trombe, gyrophares bleus et rouges allumés.

sentences.text_target: The officers stepped out and looked around the quiet street.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈɒfɪsəz stɛpt aʊt ænd lʊkt əˈraʊnd ðə ˈkwaɪət striːt/
sentences.text_native: Les agents descendirent du véhicule et inspectèrent la rue calme.

sentences.text_target: The suspicious person had already disappeared into the dark night.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə səˈspɪʃəs ˈpɜːsn hæd ɔːˈrɛdi ˌdɪsəˈpɪəd ɪntuː ðə dɑːk naɪt/
sentences.text_native: L'individu suspect avait déjà disparu dans la nuit noire.

sentences.text_target: Sarah finally felt safe when she spoke with the police officers.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə ˈfaɪnəli fɛlt seɪf wɛn ʃiː spəʊk wɪð ðə pəˈliːs ˈɒfɪsəz/
sentences.text_native: Sarah finit par se sentir en sécurité lorsqu'elle put parler aux policiers.

sentences.text_target: She answered their questions and described the unknown man.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈɑːnsəd ðɛə ˈkwɛstʃənz ænd dɪˈskraɪbd ði ˈʌnnəʊn mæn/
sentences.text_native: Elle répondit à leurs questions et fit la description de cet homme.

sentences.text_target: The officers wrote down her statement in an official notebook.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈɒfɪsəz rəʊt daʊn hɜː ˈsteɪtmənt ɪn ən əˈfɪʃəl ˈnəʊtbʊk/
sentences.text_native: Les agents consignèrent sa déposition dans leur carnet officiel.

sentences.text_target: They offered to drive her safely back to her home address.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɒfəd tuː draɪv hɜː ˈseɪfli bæk tuː hɜː həʊm əˈdrɛs/
sentences.text_native: Ils lui proposèrent de la raccompagner chez elle en toute sécurité.
